subject: french

moments.title: 18 Brumaire coup
moments.body: Napoleon's coup ends the Directory and begins the Consulate.

moments.title: Code civil
moments.body: The Napoleonic Code influences legal systems in much of Europe, Latin America and beyond.

moments.title: Waterloo
moments.body: Napoleon's defeat ends his 100 days. He is exiled to Saint Helena.
moments.takeaway: European geopolitics was reset by one battle.

now.title: Napoleon's legacy now
now.body: The Code civil still underpins French law. Napoleon's status as hero or tyrant remains contested.
now.open_questions: How should France remember an emperor who reinstated slavery in 1802?

reflection: Modern French institutions are still organised by Napoleon's choices.
